statements.status_notes: The primary advisory is for cmov, not ctutils: cmov versions before 0.4.4 can emit non-constant-time branches in their 32-bit ARM fallback. In uv 0.13.7, ctutils 0.4.2 depends on cmov 0.5.4, which already contains the fix. Shell also ships only native Linux amd64 and arm64 executables, not the affected 32-bit ARM target. See https://github.com/RustSec/advisory-db/blob/main/crates/cmov/RUSTSEC-2026-0003.md and the dependency versions at https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/blob/0.13.7/Cargo.lock.

NiFi ships the prebuilt uv binary from astral-sh/uv release 0.13.5 at /home/nifi/.local/bin/uv. The finding is in uv's embedded Rust dependency tree; remediation requires a newer uv release that updates the affected crate versions. ctutils 0.4.4 fixes this advisory.
